productpage-view.note: Example for the Bookinfo in k8s-bookinfo, reached through `kubectl port-forward -n bookinfo svc/productpage 18080:9080`. The strings are the page's own, from src/productpage/templates/productpage.html. Replace them if your application differs.

book-rating-view.note: Honest limit: with reviews-v1 only (no ratings call) the page never shows stars, so this check cannot prove ratings works; it proves the reviews section renders without a ratings error. With reviews-v2 or v3, add the star marker 'id="glyphicon glyphicon-star"' to mustContain.

book-details-lookup.note: Needs the product page and the details service: the details table (ISBN-10, Publisher) is rendered only when details answered.
